Welcome to this learning path on Grafana Profiles Drilldown. Profiles Drilldown is a Grafana app for browsing profiling data from [Grafana Pyroscope](https://grafana.com/docs/pyroscope/latest/). It's queryless: you move through services, labels, and flame graphs instead of writing queries by hand.

In this journey, you'll open Profiles Drilldown, explore services and labels, read a flame graph, and compare two profiles side by side.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this journey, you'll be able to:

- Open Profiles Drilldown and explore your services
- Group a service by labels to isolate an anomaly
- Read a flame graph to see where a service spends its resources
- Compare two processes with a diff flame graph
- Optionally use Grafana Assistant/flame graph AI to summarize what you're looking at

## More to explore

You'll also see optional links to related docs when they're useful. Skip them if you want to stay on the path.

## Before you begin

You need:

- A Grafana Cloud stack with Profiles Drilldown and a Profiles (Pyroscope) data source. This journey uses the public Grafana Play Profiles data source, so you don't need your own profiles flowing yet.
